column3: Directly pairs Rabb with al-A'la; anchors f02's highest governing source.
Adds a social-standing use of wajh, keeping f03 distinct from devotional direction.
Broad Rabb frame supports f02's sustaining governance, though 87:1 already states it more pointedly.
Direct Rabb-wajh parallel adds permanence and a stable ultimate orientation.
Immediate outcome card: satisfaction completes the preceding exclusive seeking.
Contrast evidence against transgressive self-exaltation bounds f04.
Gives a spatial-high boundary for al-A'la, distinct from status or sovereignty.
Immediate scope card places both endpoints under the same claim.
Supports non-human, encompassing al-'Ali authority; less exact than 87:1.
Exact seeking-Rabb-wajh construction joins endurance, worship, giving, and repair.
Preserves the temporal-face, staged reversal reading; it is remote from 92:20's route.
Rabb of the House links worship to sustained provision, but is a broader parallel.

Immediate guidance claim supplies the governing route behind the focus.
Exact giving-for-seeking-wajh formula adds nonreciprocal giving and personal accountability.

Immediate creation-pairing context supports the surah's differentiated pattern.
Boundary against overreaching usefully preserves f04 as a limiting reading.
Intentional seeking of approval is parallel but qualified by an introduced institution.

Combines true kingship, transcendence, and Rabb; broad but relevant f02 frame.

Immediate day-unveiling image only weakly supports the focus's orientation language.
Explicitly directs wajh toward the creator, a central orientation parallel.
Extends wajh beyond fixed place, though it is less specific after 6:79.
Guidance from the creator parallels the immediate guidance context.
Triple Rabb framing reinforces comprehensive governance but is redundant with earlier cards.
Physical wajh supplies a different surface sense, with limited focus value.
Immediate warning supplies the opposed consequence within the local sequence.
Contrasts face-down movement with a straight route, supporting f01 orientation indirectly.
No-payment stance and a path toward Rabb support nontransactional orientation.

Retains a competing-object-of-seeking boundary, but it is general.

Separates transcendent elevation from location and preserves a secondary Rabb reading.

Publicly visible wajh outcome is secondary to the focus's directional use.
Immediate punishment card develops the warned contrary result.
Immediate affirmation of al-husna supplies the positive branch's commitment.
Radiant wajh preserves outcome and public-standing readings alongside direction.
A sound-heart criterion is only an indirect sincerity parallel.
Generic mercy of Rabb adds little after stronger care readings.
Explicit submission of wajh joins firm attachment with active good conduct.
Seeking Rabb's mercy frames withholding with gentle speech, a secondary ethical parallel.

Rejected contrast only; it supplies a remote transcendence boundary.
The high assembly is not connected to the focus's readings.
Immediate restriction of the fire defines the negative endpoint.
Boundary-crossing seeking is a distant contrary use of the root.
Bare exception formula has no indicated connection.
Comforted faces preserve a public-outcome reading, already well covered.
Direct feeding for Allah's wajh and refusal of return makes the motive nonreciprocal.
Submission of wajh plus good conduct parallels 31:22 but is now redundant.
Immediate denial of al-husna supplies the negative branch's commitment.
Envious baghy offers a contrary motive but little direct focus clarification.
The highest exemplar distinguishes divine valuation from debased human attribution.
Sustained Rabb care is directly elaborated by its near context; strong f02 support.
Seeking another object despite received favor gives a competing-direction contrast.
Desiring His wajh is set against worldly adornment, directly clarifying motive and boundary.
Immediate stinginess and self-sufficiency define the opposed disposition.
Granted high station is a secondary status sense of elevation.
Highest exemplar is broadly related but adds little after 16:60 and 87:1.
Rabb's giving culminating in satisfaction closely parallels 92:21's outcome.
Refuge in shared Rabb authority is a remote relational parallel.
Giving due rights to vulnerable people is explicitly joined to desiring Allah's wajh.
Immediate pious avoidance of the fire identifies the positive recipient.
Rabb-given recompense is broad and redundant with stronger outcome cards.
Bare exception scene has no indicated focus connection.
Measured response to renewed baghy supplies a justice boundary for f04.
High ranks lack an indicated route to the focus readings.
Large-scale arrogant elevation and corruption preserve a contrary al-'uluw boundary.
Fire is locally relevant but this isolated card adds no focus-specific evidence.
Rabb-directed warning before the Hour supports f02 indirectly.
Messenger-of-Rabb phrasing offers only generic governance support.
Refusal of human payment supports nontransactional service, though not the exact wajh formula.
Commanded agency under Rabb is too general after the main governance parallels.
Rabb's command gives a broad authority parallel with little added specificity.
Direct yuriduna wajhahu wording supplies a closely parallel, sustained devotional orientation.
The exception of wajh supplies a decisive permanence boundary alongside 55:27.
Wealth-giving is explicitly tied to seeking divine approval and inner steadfastness.
Self-expenditure for divine approval extends the focus beyond monetary giving.
Self-purification benefits the actor, directly clarifying the yatzakka strand in 92:18.
Exclusive, purified devotion supplies a foundational sincerity parallel to the focus's exception.
Purified, exclusive worship gives a direct formal parallel to single-source intention.
Whole-life devotion is expressly directed to Allah as Rabb of all realms.
Purification immediately precedes the Rabb-remembrance card already retrieved at 87:15.
The feeding action immediately preceding 76:9 completes that direct motive parallel.
Faces are directed toward their Rabb, completing the 75:22 outcome-orientation sequence.
Showy spending is a direct contrary motive that protects the focus from human-facing display.
Spending for public display supplies the same contrary motive in an independent setting.
Showy worship preserves a broader contrary reading of acts detached from exclusive orientation.
Giving in expectation of increase supplies a compact boundary against return-seeking.
Preferring others despite need adds a concrete non-self-serving giving pattern.
Spending what one loves strengthens the costly-giving side of the local positive branch.
Good sent ahead for oneself supports the focus's non-human-repayment logic.
What is with Allah remains, supporting the focus's ultimate rather than transient orientation.
Temporary adornment is set against what is better and more lasting with Allah.
The lasting final end provides a concise destination contrast for the focus's seeking.
A worldly-life motive supplies a clear contrary target of desire.
Immediate-life desire supplies a second contrary motivational route.
Contrasts cultivation for the final end with cultivation confined to the present world.
Honor-seeking is redirected to Allah, preserving a counterweight to f03 status readings.
Following divine approval is contrasted with incurring wrath, a close intention boundary.
Preference for the immediate world against the weighty later day supplies a motive contrast.
Wealth as present adornment versus lasting righteous deeds is a broader value parallel.
Competitive accumulation supplies a distant contrary to the focus's exclusive aim.
Intense attachment to wealth is a secondary contrary to giving without return.
